title: sabina lycia
intro: Sabina lycia, commonly known as juniper, is a coniferous evergreen tree native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of sabina lycia include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve urinary tract issues, and lower blood pressure due to its diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of sabina lycia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of sabina lycia include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
